messages:
mira: Heads-up: DAST pipeline spiked in nightly staging — ~30% more failed checks, lots of auth/timeouts. Repro steps below. Anyone else seeing noise?
evans: yup saw it, looks like ephemeral auth tokens expired earlier. Scanner logs show 401 and occasional 502 from test harness.
samir: failing scans across multiple PRs — seems correlated with staging autoscaler flapping (containers restarted), scanner can't complete interactive sessions.
jen: dumping a sample log chunk:```
2026-03-22T03:12:01Z scanner: session-start
2026-03-22T03:12:14Z platform: container terminated (OOM?)
2026-03-22T03:12:15Z scanner: got 502 while hitting /login
2026-03-22T03:12:16Z scanner: token refresh failed: 401
```
policy-bot: FYI: existing RBAC grants for scanner service account expire every 24h — that's by design for least privilege.
mira: Proposal: add a "scan-stability" workflow:
- pin ephemeral role for duration of nightly run
- record audit log entries for role grant + token issuance
- if scanner sees >10% auth errors, auto-retry with fresh grant and flag owner
evans: +1. Need to also capture infra signals (container restart count). Suggest adding a small shim to scanner runner to emit telemetry to /observability/scan-stability.
samir: quick GH Action snippet to try:
```
- name: request-ephemeral-scan-role
  run: curl -X POST https://internal-api/grant?purpose=nightly-scan -H "Authorization: ${{ secrets.SCAN_GRANT_TOKEN }}"
```
mira: Also @ops-oncall: can we add an incident sub-route for "scan-flakiness" with playbook steps? e.g., check KMS token validity, check RBAC binding age, restart scanner runner, re-run scans.
ops-oncall: yep — I'll add to the incident runbook. Also will create a dashboard for "scan auth failures" and tie to pager with a very low priority initially.
jen: question: audit logging — how long do we keep the ephemeral grant records? Compliance wants 1 year of grant evidence.
policy-bot: current retention is 90 days for ephemeral-grants — need ticket to extend to 1 year, may be extra cost.
mira: filing ticket: SDLC-4578. Need input from Security and Finance on retention costs.
samir: I'll prototype jittered retries + a drain check to avoid scanning during container churn. Will push a small change to runner.
evans: thx. If folks agree, I'll schedule a canary run this week after the protos land.
mira: Agreed. Next steps: samir prototype, evans dashboard, ops-oncall add playbook, policy-bot escalate retention ticket. Ping here when PRs linked.
